exam.title: AWS Certified Developer - Associate
exam.study_prerequisites: No formal prerequisite; AWS targets developers with at least one year building and maintaining AWS applications. Practice one high-level language, SDK/API use, Lambda, API Gateway, events/messages/streams, DynamoDB, caching, identity/tokens, KMS/secrets, SAM/CloudFormation, testing, deployment strategies, observability, failure injection and measured optimization.

review.notes: The current version 2.1 DVA-C02 guide was reconciled with four weighted domains, technologies/concepts, service scope, revisions and the live exam page. The guide maps all added and removed scope and distinguishes the AI-assisted emerging list as possible unscored pretest content. Three scenarios, eight labs and 40 original checks cover resilient APIs/events/Lambda/data, security/tenancy, artifact/test/release/rollback and evidence-driven troubleshooting/optimization. All 25 URLs are cataloged: 21 reachable and two O'Reilly plus two Udemy pages automation-blocked; none missing or broken. Volatile metadata is labeled and no recalled questions are used. September 17, 2026 delivery maintenance: checked the live AWS certification page and added the applicable language retirement or replacement-exam notice, including conflicting vendor dates where present. Existing objective snapshot and full-review dates remain unchanged. See docs/research/2026-09-17-exam-validation.md.

findings.title: C02 last-delivery conflict persists
findings.evidence: Credential page December 1 versus September announcement November 30.
findings.recommendation: Keep the support limitation visible pending authoritative evidence.

findings.title: Order example can lose an event after database commit
findings.evidence: Separate state write and event publish are not atomic.
findings.recommendation: Use atomic state/outbox plus durable relay and consumer idempotency; add failure-injection lab.
findings.resolution: Use atomic state/outbox plus durable relay and consumer idempotency; add failure-injection lab.

findings.title: Partial batch retries differ by event source
findings.evidence: Kinesis retries from lowest failed checkpoint; standard SQS identifies failed messages; FIFO reports unprocessed records too.
findings.recommendation: Add source-specific table-equivalent explanation and worked retry sets.
findings.resolution: Add source-specific table-equivalent explanation and worked retry sets.

findings.title: X-Ray SDK/daemon maintenance needs a learning update
findings.evidence: Current timeline says maintenance since February 25, 2026 and no specified end date.
findings.recommendation: Add maintenance boundary and OpenTelemetry migration reference without implying service retirement.
findings.resolution: Add maintenance boundary and OpenTelemetry migration reference without implying service retirement.
